propositions: Six subsystems triaged 439 files in src/rebar with ~2,033 estimated recoverable comment lines by relocating history to tickets, architecture to ADRs, logic to code, and contracts to schema.
Self-referential 800-LOC-cap prose occupies 28 sites in reconciler; removing it recovers headroom in constrained modules (runner.py 3→48, _ref_lock.py 1→21, dispatch_one.py 14→57).
Three files (_store/event_append.py, reducer/_processors.py, signing.py) cannot be reduced because their comments encode replay-compatibility and security invariants that are load-bearing.
Verified-stale comments found documenting outdated invariants (e.g., deterministic floor documented as P1-P9 while DET_CHECKS runs P1-P11; Anthropic constraint marked stale in same module).
Each shard's do_not_move list must be appended to .joe-janitor/tools.md before landing to prevent future sweeps from re-flagging load-bearing blocks.

Nine new ADRs (0062-0069) consolidate arguments currently restated 4–8 times across shards; net measured recovery across six shards is ~85 comment lines (output of work, not target), dominated by RELOCATE+CORRECT-IN-PLACE rather than DELETE.
